event.description: Use squared-ReLU normalized attention with one QKV union
event.proposal: Family: attention organization. Current retained frontier is 1,640 parameters at 99.000000%, exactly threshold. There have been 22 prior macro-attempts in this family. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0146/micro-0011 at 1,640/99.00%; the most recent failed result is attempt-0152, whose normalized sigmoid attention scored 0.00% at 1,639. Hypothesis: sigmoid failed because it compresses strong compatibilities, while squared ReLU preserves positive score magnitude and sparsifies negative routes. Add QKV pair 608/539, keep incumbent dot products and temperature, replace softmax by squared-ReLU row normalization, yielding 1,639 parameters. This is more informative than plain ReLU because squaring restores a sharper winner preference closer to softmax.
